title: Adjective Order Before Nouns
grammarTitle: Adjective Order — How to Stack Adjectives Naturally
grammarNote: В английском языке прилагательные перед существительным располагаются в определённом порядке. Нарушение этого порядка делает предложение неестественным, хотя технически не всегда неправильным. Носители языка инстинктивно чувствуют этот порядок, но для изучающих его нужно запомнить. Порядок: Мнение → Размер → Возраст → Форма → Цвет → Происхождение → Материал → Назначение → Существительное.

rows.example: "a beautiful, interesting, extraordinary..." — your judgement of the thing.
"big, tiny, enormous, large, small, short, tall..."
"old, young, new, ancient, modern, medieval..."
"round, square, oval, flat, curved..."
"blue, red, dark green, golden, pale..."
"Kazakh, Soviet, French, Central Asian..."
"wooden, glass, silk, leather, stone, metal..."
"sleeping (bag), writing (desk), cooking (pot)..."
"a beautiful large old library" (opinion → size → age) ✅
"a small old Soviet building" (size → age → origin) ✅
"a lovely old wooden bench" (opinion → age → material) ✅
"a large golden Kazakh ornament" (size → colour → origin) ✅

rows.form: You rarely use more than 2-3 adjectives
rows.example: "a beautiful old building" (2 adj) is natural. "a beautiful old large Soviet wooden building" = too many!
Native speakers feel "a nice old café" naturally before "an old nice café."
"a red Russian flag" (colour before origin) ✅. Not "a Russian red flag."
"a small old wooden table" — wooden is close to "table." ✅
✅ "a beautiful OLD building" — opinion before age.
✅ "a small old wooden table" — size → age → material.
✅ "an amazing red Russian flag" — opinion → colour → origin.
✅ "a comfortable old leather reading chair" — opinion → age → material → purpose.

grammarTip:
Порядок прилагательных — запомни фразу:
"Opinions Seldom Actually Shape Completely Organised Material Products"
O-S-A-S-C-O-M-P
Мнение → Размер → Возраст → Форма → Цвет → Происхождение → Материал → Назначение

💡 На практике обычно используют 2-3 прилагательных максимум:
"a beautiful old library" ✅
"a large old Soviet building" ✅
"a lovely old wooden bench" ✅

⚠️ Если что-то звучит «не так» — доверяй интуиции:
"a old beautiful library" → звучит неправильно → порядок нарушен!

exercises.hint: Opinion (beautiful) → Size (small) → Age (old). "a BEAUTIFUL SMALL OLD café." ✅
Age (old) → Shape (round) → Material (wooden). "an OLD ROUND WOODEN table." ✅
Size (large) → Age (old) → Origin (Soviet). "a LARGE OLD SOVIET building." ✅

exercises.text: "A wooden old beautiful bench" is in the correct adjective order.
exercises.hint: ✅ "A BEAUTIFUL OLD WOODEN bench." — Opinion (beautiful) → Age (old) → Material (wooden). ✅

exercises.instruction: Put the adjectives in the correct order.
exercises.hint: Opinion (interesting) → Age (old) → Origin (Kazakh). "an INTERESTING OLD KAZAKH book." ✅
Size (small) → Colour (green) → Purpose (indicator). "SMALL GREEN INDICATOR lights." ✅

exercises.instruction: Which is NOT in the correct order?
exercises.hint: ✗ "an old wooden beautiful box." ✅ Should be: "a BEAUTIFUL OLD WOODEN box." Opinion comes FIRST.
Opinion (comfortable) → Age (old) → Material (wooden). "a COMFORTABLE OLD WOODEN chair." ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct order: opinion or age first?

questions.text: "a beautiful small old library" — what is the order?
questions.hint: Opinion (beautiful) → Size (small) → Age (old) → noun. This is correct! ✅

questions.text: "a wooden round old table" — what is wrong?
opts: Material should be last: "old round wooden"
questions.correct: Material should be last: "old round wooden"
questions.hint: ✅ "an OLD ROUND WOODEN table." — Age (old) → Shape (round) → Material (wooden). Material is last.

questions.text: "large old Soviet building" — which position is "origin"?
questions.hint: Size (large) → Age (old) → Origin (Soviet). Origin comes after size and age, before material. ✅

questions.text: Which adjective type always comes first?
questions.hint: Opinion adjectives (beautiful, nice, interesting) ALWAYS come first in any combination. ✅

questions.text: "a ___ café" — put in order: (small / old / traditional)
questions.hint: Size (small) → Age (old) → Opinion/character (traditional). "a SMALL OLD TRADITIONAL café." ✅

questions.text: "a Kazakh golden small ring" — correct order?
opts: No — should be "a small golden Kazakh ring"
No — should be "a golden Kazakh small ring"
No — should be "a small Kazakh golden ring"
questions.correct: No — should be "a small golden Kazakh ring"
questions.hint: ✅ Size (small) → Colour (golden) → Origin (Kazakh). "a SMALL GOLDEN KAZAKH ring." ✅

opts: Near the noun, after most other adjectives
questions.correct: Near the noun, after most other adjectives
questions.hint: Material (wooden, glass, leather) goes after origin and before purpose — near the noun.
Opinion (beautiful) → Size (small) → Material (silver). "a BEAUTIFUL SMALL SILVER ring." ✅

questions.text: "a comfortable old leather reading chair" uses the order:
How many adjectives is a comfortable and natural limit?
questions.hint: 2-3 adjectives is natural. "a beautiful old building" / "a small round table." More sounds unnatural.

questions.text: "an old nice library" — what sounds wrong?
opts: "old" should come before "nice" — but opinion goes first
questions.correct: "old" should come before "nice" — but opinion goes first
questions.hint: ✅ "a NICE OLD library." — Opinion (nice) must come before Age (old).

opts: No — should be "amazing red Russian flag"
questions.correct: No — should be "amazing red Russian flag"
questions.hint: ✅ Opinion (amazing) → Colour (red) → Origin (Russian). "an AMAZING RED RUSSIAN flag." ✅
✅ Opinion (beautiful) → Age (old) → Material (wooden) → noun (box). "a BEAUTIFUL OLD WOODEN box." ✅

questions.text: "She found ___ photographs." (old / black and white / small)
questions.hint: Size (small) → Age (old) → Colour (black and white). "SMALL OLD BLACK AND WHITE photographs." ✅
Order: Opinion → Size → Age → Shape → Colour → Origin → Material. Shape comes 4th. ✅
